title: polygala polymorpha var. comosa
intro: Polygala polymorpha var. comosa, commonly known as Running Goldenseal or Polygala comosa, is a perennial herb in the Polygalaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to support kidney and urinary tract health, and is believed to have anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Running Goldenseal include its potential to act as a diuretic and to help reduce swelling, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Polygala comosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
